reviews.text: We were there at a quarter to seven in the morning, still on duty. We rang the bell, nothing, several times. Meanwhile, people were coming and going through the other gate, they weren't bothered at all. All this if we get in for a 37,000 HUF duty fee, it's pure laughter. Avoid them as much as possible, I don't care about their explanations either.
I have very good experiences.
He's there when you need him in trouble.. ❤️‍🩹 …
The doctor's incredibly fast and accurate diagnosis saved our beloved Bernie's life, the hospital staff is kind and helpful. We are very grateful, thank you very much.

In September, my dog ​​was found to have oral carcinoma. In such cases, quick surgery is very important. Dr. Juhász immediately took my dog ​​in for surgery and operated with excellent results. He communicated very honestly and empathetically. I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw my dog ​​after a mandibular resection. It is practically invisible.
Thank you very much for the extremely helpful and 5-star care in every respect, both professionally and personally.

The arrogance of the receptionist “lady” cost our dog her life. She made us wait at the gate for about 5 minutes and when she was willing to let us in, she “administrated” for another 5 minutes and then made us wait for another 2-3 minutes, while she saw what condition our dog was in. Our address, our phone number and her telling us five times that the on-call fee was 35 thousand forints were more important than the immediate care of our dog. We constantly felt that why were we bothering them at night. The vet also had a similar attitude towards us. Then, after they told us that our dog had to be taken elsewhere, she slowly finished the administration. It is incomprehensible how people like this can be allowed to work in an animal hospital. Zero empathy, maximum arrogance. Anyone who knows, avoid this place!!!!
I can only say the worst about them... Not anywhere but here!
A very kind doctor examined our dog!! I definitely recommend her if there is a problem!!!
We came in on Sunday evening with an allergic reaction to a wasp sting. They were helpful and kind. They took great care of my dog ​​and we barely had to wait.

They saw us very quickly even without an appointment. Dr. Beáta László was very kind, attentive and professional. Her detailed information and positive attitude immediately reassured us in a difficult situation. I wholeheartedly recommend the clinic and the doctor to everyone! Thank you very much for your help!

They were very good at it and unscrupulously informed me before payment that the price given on the phone was only possible with kp. Since I was prepared to pay by card, I only had my pet brought if I paid an invoice with VAT.
The price of the intervention was announced in advance, but later I received the answer that it is based on an individual price calculation each time. (Unrealistically high)
Dr. Zoltán András really knows his stuff, if he weren't there I would only give it 2 stars!
Words cannot express how grateful I am!!! Very professional and kind helpful team! Thank you very much! I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart!
They called me almost immediately after arrival. After a quick check, I was given a vaccination.

We took our King Charles Cavalier Spaniel to the evening emergency room, Doctor Beáta and her lovely assistant quickly treated our dog Coco 🐶, who had a really bad earache, and had a lump removed from it! We would like to thank you very much 🙏❤️ Andrea Baranyi (Mogyoród) …
Excellent, polite and fast service on a Sunday afternoon.

I do not recommend this veterinary clinic to anyone! What a shameless rip-off that is going on here😡, it's expensive and dirty, but the fact that they are not humane at all doesn't mean they want to help...it should be avoided by all means

I only give one star because there is no 0. Horrible place! Our puppy was sent home with a broken jaw, they looked into his mouth and only saw a broken tooth and said that it would fall out at the first meal, they explained his lethargy by a false pregnancy. The next day we called them that he was not better, the answer: they should read the medical record, false pregnancy. We took him to another doctor where they immediately diagnosed the fracture by looking at him. This lack of professional preparation is below critical. The dear Doctor and her assistant were fiddling around in front of our eyes and ears while our dog was experiencing tremendous pain. They ignored our phone call. When we went back to complain, they ignored us, they lied that the Doctor we wanted to talk to while she was running around and seeing patients saw and heard that we were looking for her but she didn't have enough respect to apologize! Dr. Tamás Juhász, the chief physician, educated us on our phone call and claimed that our dog had surgery that evening and was fine, so we shouldn't complain. We stayed in the office with the dog for 3 minutes, not to mention there was no surgery, nor was there any normal care. Thanks to another hospital and doctor, he is fine now, but due to the delayed intervention he was at risk of infection. Disgusting and shameless people!!! I wish them to experience this and no one can help them, because the animal is the most defenseless, it can't tell you what hurts it! A complaint has been filed, but if it's not enough, we will take all necessary steps to bring justice to the little one who suffered for 3 days because of them!!
Medical error, the animal was not even examined! Phlegm, arrogant style. A slanderer will not leave the mouth of any employee. Anyone who wants good, do not set foot here!!

I do not recommend it to anyone who wants to see their pet alive.
I brought my dog ​​in on Sunday morning because I saw him listless the night before, which was confirmed by the fact that he hadn't eaten his dinner in the morning. I measured his fever, it was high!
A young doctor took him in for treatment.
After the ultrasound, she said that he had stomach and intestinal inflammation. After four injections of infusion, he was released home, with the words that he had to come for a check-up on Monday, and then the lab will be done. We are now at 99750.ft.
They let him go home at 11.45, I had to take him back at 14.30 because his condition had worsened, another ultrasound, X-ray, needless to say, 3 hours later the doctor came up with a completely new diagnosis, now his lungs had collapsed, but not due to pneumonia. But during the X-ray, my little one stopped breathing, this was the last time I saw my 3-year-old breeding dog, winner in several countries, alive.
I miss him so much! He was a family member!
In the past, there was someone who knew what to do in such cases, now they live off cremation!
For 192,000, they even liquidated the entire laboratory for the dead dog!
Completely correct!

We were there 2x at night and we couldn't even get in. We didn't get the slightest help. The assistant's helpfulness was 10/0 We waited for hours on the street at dawn because we couldn't even get in.....

Unfortunately, my 10-month-old dog ate a very large piece of his plastic toy, so we went to the clinic with him in the middle of the night. When we got there, you could already feel that our presence was a burden for the young lady working there. She told me that there was a scale there, let me weigh my dog, and after taking the data, she brought a dog out of the clinic, while we waited outside at the reception. Up until now, this would not have been a problem, since we cannot expect the kindness that most clinics provide to both pets and their owners. She pushed the dog into the middle of the reception, then the lady working there pressed 2 bags, a few pieces of sylvia into my hand and said that he would vomit now, so we should leave as soon as possible, and that she would like to ask for 58,000 HUF. Of course, the condition of my dog ​​was the most important thing at that moment, but when I looked at the bill the next day, I was completely amazed that they had written off the on-call fee and medication, 17,000 HUF with the heading “Vomiting”. I find it extremely outrageous that they asked for extra money for a service that I actually performed with my dog ​​in the park opposite the clinic. When I called the clinic the next day to inquire about what exactly I paid this amount for, the answer was “Because the colleague asked when her dog had dinner and told her how the vomiting process would go.” I find the whole thing incredibly surreal. Please, if you can, do not bring your pet here!

Yesterday, 2026.07.29, we arrived at the clinic with my pregnant dog. The fifth puppy was stuck and a caesarean section was suspected. Fortunately, it was born in the waiting room and 40 minutes later the last one emerged. The clinic staff and the doctors did a very precise and correct job. Thank you very much
Undorito is a place that only takes money and doesn't care about animals
My dog ​​had a tumor removed. After excellent care and a successful surgery, he is now running around. I received the right treatment and excellent care. Thank you.

After a phone consultation, they waited for us at the clinic, where we drove for 30 minutes, the animal's data was recorded, and then we waited. After ten minutes, the doctor told us in an unqualified style that he could not see us because he did not have time. We left disappointed. It was supposed to be a vaccination, which takes about 3 minutes. I do not recommend the clinic to anyone!

Unfortunately, we took our little African hedgehog to its last journey in a night shift. In theory, they only take care of dogs and cats on duty, but they said on the intercom that if anesthesia is really needed, they will help the pet without further ado.

The lady who performed the euthanasia was incredibly kind and empathetic, explained everything, and let me be with her until the last moment. She only suggested that the last phase was not necessarily worth watching, but by then the hedgehog was already fast asleep.

When she brought out her little body, it was carefully placed in the box that we had brought with us, and although it was a very small gesture, there was a small heart on the hedgehog, which was very touching.

And what was especially kind to my soul that evening, when handing over the body, the lady added that “it was a good decision” (and then supported this with professional reasons), so my soul could have been a little lighter.

So, as positive as such an experience can be, our experience was as positive as it gets. Thank you very much for your empathetic attitude.

Nice, clean animal hospital.
Unfortunately, my friend's dog had to be put down because her condition due to her old age no longer allowed her to live a happy life🖤the doctor and his assistant were empathetic. Actually, the receptionist too, although she answered so many phone calls that she barely had time to deal with the owners. It's great that they are open 0-24 hours, and even the 37,000.- HUF emergency fee is not that high compared to other animal hospitals.
I can recommend the place if necessary, although it does not have a barrier-free entrance.
A cultured place, two nice, helpful ladies were working when we went. The dog was taken care of. Thank you for the help!

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the staff at the animal hospital, especially Dr. Ingrid Rácz and Dr. Nóra Szemző.

Our kitten swallowed a thread and needed urgent surgery. During the 3 nights she spent there, she received professional care, and we received answers to all our questions.

We were completely satisfied with the quality of the care and the prices. The kitten was examined several times a day, had an ultrasound, and we could inquire about her condition by phone at any time. Once again, we would like to thank you for everything and we wholeheartedly recommend the animal hospital!
They are always very helpful. Highly knowledgeable doctors.

We arrived at night around 1 am, we had to wait because a cat was being operated on. After half an hour of waiting, we were admitted with vomiting and bloody stool. The Dr. was very helpful. Since then, we have been to them 3 times and the dog has recovered. If someone were looking for a veterinary hospital at night, I would definitely recommend them.
I would like to thank them again.

I was there last week for a pre-arranged vomiting procedure because my dog ​​swallowed an avocado seed.
I put my dog ​​on the table, then he got the suri.
The suri was effective of course,
then I went out to pay, they said the bill would be sent by email, so I didn't see what the details included.
In addition to the injection, they also charged me for an examination for 15,000 HUF, which didn't happen, and they didn't even touch the dog.
I wrote to them about my indignation, as a complaint (consumer) twice, that they were unjustifiably and badly worded, but there is no answer, even though they are legally obliged to do so.
I don't recommend it to anyone, and I suggest that everyone arrange in advance and find out on the spot before paying ....

I absolutely do not recommend this place! The clinic is completely unprofessional, careless and indifferent. After a single examination, our dog was diagnosed with a sprain – no X-ray, no ultrasound, no tests were done. In addition, our dog received a steroid injection, twice the amount allowed, as a result of which he has been behaving aggressively ever since: constantly growling and barking in the apartment. Avoid him from afar!
The doctors here are good and skilled.

The whole thing was a tragicomedy. The assistant behaved terribly, 0 empathy. We went to Supervet yesterday with a cat, they didn't accept us, because they were overloaded. We ended up here. 37,000 HUF duty fee.... There were 5 of us before us, we got there around 11 pm, and we were admitted after 3 hours (Dr. Regina was great). After the assistant called everyone in before us, "just like that" everyone else was already stuck, not just us. She even called a dog in last who had a tick in its ear, and we were the last to go in with the feverish, sick, vomiting cat. Because there is an emergency order... a tick since when? Those who came, oh my, we go in because... outrageous. In principle, there is an order of arrival, and if someone has to come here, that's why urgent. 1 doctor is working, operating, a tragedy, horror. A very shoddy place, no price list. Shame on Juhàszzęk.

Life-threatening negligence: Why avoid Juhász Pet Clinic from afar?
If your pet's life is in danger, the worst decision you can make is to entrust it to this clinic. Superficial examinations, air-borne diagnoses and serious omissions characterize the place. Because of them, our 17-year-old Siamese cat, Moka, who was loved as a family member, is currently fighting for her life, because she lost a significant part of her chances of survival at their place.
We urgently brought the cat in because she suddenly became completely depressed, did not eat, and was apparently in serious pain. After a superficial "ultrasound", the doctor examining her at Juhász Clinic coldly reported the "facts": the cat's kidneys were "decayed", her tongue was ulcerated, she had severe stomatitis, and due to her age, the situation was unsalvageable. They painted a picture of a terminally ill animal, doomed to die. He did not receive any meaningful, life-saving or targeted treatment; we were simply sent home with this shocking diagnosis, while our cat lay helpless and suffering at home.
Moreover, we received this wrong, negligent opinion after a 4-hour wait, for which we were billed 72 thousand forints. The clinic is unable to provide even the most basic human comfort to owners in a crisis situation: there is not even a working water machine or soda machine in the waiting room. What is even more depressing: during our time there, we saw 4 other emergency cases come in, and all four ended up being sedated. Although we cannot know the professional background, the statistics are more than a warning sign.
Since we saw that the kitten's condition was critical, we immediately transferred him to another clinic (All-in Vet). Here, they immediately performed the basic tests that Juhász Clinic had missed (detailed blood count and IDEXX lab), and that's when we got our second shock: not a single word of the diagnosis given at Juhász Clinic was true.
At the new clinic, professional, intensive care and effective pain relief began immediately, but the most painful sentence came only after that from the competent doctor: if he had received this treatment even just a day earlier, the kitten's chances would have been orders of magnitude better.
Due to the incompetence of Juhász Clinic, we lost a critical day - a day during which the inflammation freely destroyed his body, and because of which we now have to face the horror of peritonitis and euthanasia.
Unfortunately, this is not an isolated case with them: months ago, we experienced eerily similar, indifferent care from them with our dog. In light of our current tragedy, it is terrifying to think how many unsuspecting pets could have fallen victim to this type of medical negligence.
We have learned our lesson for life, but it is deeply outrageous that our family member could pay with their life for their unprofessionalism.
The clinic is characterized by incredible unprofessionalism and unethical behavior, not recommended.

If your pet's life is at stake, avoid this clinic - Unprofessionalism, fabricated diagnoses and repeated mistakes
I do not recommend Juhász Pet Clinic to anyone, especially not if your pet has a serious, acute problem. Due to their amazing superficiality and unprofessionalism, our 17-year-old Siamese cat, Moka, who was loved as a family member, lost a significant part of her chances of survival.
We brought our cat in with the complaint that she suddenly became completely depressed, did not eat and was visibly unwell. At Juhász Clinic, the doctor who performed the examination told us that the ultrasound showed that the cat's "kidneys had collapsed", and that she also had an ulcerated tongue, "stomatitis" (inflammation of the mouth) and tartar. Based on this and her age, they essentially painted a terminal, hopeless picture for us. He did not receive any meaningful, acute life-saving treatment that would have addressed the real problem, but we were sent home with this horrible diagnosis, while our cat was getting worse and worse at home and lying helpless.
Moreover, we received all this incorrect, indifferent and fabricated diagnosis after a 4-hour wait, for 72 thousand forints. During our 4-hour stay there, the clinic could not provide the most basic human comfort to the desperate owners: there was not a single miserable water machine or a soda machine in the waiting room. And what is most horrifying: while we were waiting there, 4 animals were put to sleep. Obviously, we cannot see the exact professional reasons, and we cannot know whether they could have been saved, but the fact that 4 out of 4 emergency cases before our eyes ended with the animal being put to sleep is more than telling and infinitely sad in retrospect.
Since we saw that the problem was huge, we took him to another clinic (All-in Vet). Here they immediately performed the tests (IDEXX lab and detailed blood count) that were missed or not taken seriously at the Juhász Clinic, and the shocking truth was revealed: NOT A SINGLE WORD of the diagnosis given at the Juhász Clinic WAS TRUE.
The lab results and the thorough examination proved in black and white: our cat's kidney functions were completely normal (creatinine levels were perfect), there was no question of a "decayed" kidney, and there were no ulcers on his tongue! The real problem that caused his collapse was a brutal, acute pancreatitis, with extremely high inflammatory values ​​(WBC: 24.23), and a serious problem affecting the biliary tract. At the other clinic, they immediately started targeted treatment, and he finally received the special painkillers that alleviated his suffering.
However, the most painful and infuriating sentence was what the truly competent veterinarian told us: if we had started this targeted treatment even just one day earlier, our cat would have had a much better chance of survival. We lost an entire day due to the shocking misdiagnosis of the Juhász Pet Clinic and the diseases he contracted from the air. A day during which the real inflammation destroyed his body without hindrance, and as a result we now have to face the horror of peritonitis and euthanasia.
And what is most frustrating: we had to realize that this was not an isolated case with them. A few months ago, we also visited them with our dog in a very similar way, and we already experienced this kind of superficiality and indifference. In light of our current tragedy, I can't even begin to imagine how many hidden medical errors, misdiagnoses, or professional shortcomings they may have made that their unsuspecting owners don't even know about.
We've learned our lesson for life, but our kitty may pay with her life for their incompetence.

We went there last night with a fecal impaction removal.
It's true, they couldn't fix the problem and we have to go to a specialist.. which is okay, I accept, but I still spent 65 thousand forints for nothing..
But it's not "annoying/disturbing"
It's the attitude of the doctor and the assistant. Not a smile, not a kind word, in fact... communication was zero.
The atmosphere of the examination/treatment was tense and impatient, they didn't even touch my dog ​​properly..it was completely obvious that they didn't feel like it right now and we were there for the dog at this time😅..

Very kind and helpful doctors and assistants work here. Unfortunately, our cat broke his leg, but thanks to them he successfully recovered. We are very grateful for everything they did for us and our cat!!!!
I do not recommend this place to anyone, do not bring your pets here!

If you want the best for your pet, you don't bring it here at night, especially if it's not that urgent. On Sunday night we went with a one and a half hour long torn wound because we were leaving for Croatia on Wednesday so that there wouldn't be an open wound on the dog's side, we wanted it to be stitched up, without us asking, the kind doctor punctured our dog in one place saying that a drain had to be inserted because the dog's wound was very dirty, it was a fresh one and a half hour long wound that we disinfected at home before we went to the doctor with him. Not to mention, after anesthesia, they tied the dog to the wall and then they were surprised that it wasn't nice. He never growled at any doctor, even when he was more nervous, this was achieved here. The next day we took him to our own doctor where 4 veterinarians looked at the dog and all four of them, including a surgical veterinarian, said that the drain was completely unnecessary in the dog. They took it out. The kind doctor is a real scaremonger. Next time I'll listen to my gut and we won't come here again. Dr. Hentes's only merit is that at least she managed to find the right medication.

On 11. 06. 2026 we had an orthopedic examination with our Beagle puppy! The young doctor who first examined the dog was very nice, kind and animal-friendly! He took care of our dog with love! Orthopedic doctor Dr. Tamás Juhász, with maximum dedication, taking several x-rays of the dog's critical body parts according to his expertise, explained everything that was important to us so that our dog could move fully again in the future!!!! Maximum respect, maximum expertise, all my appreciation to the doctors! They did not charge us unnecessary costs, only what was very important and indispensable for the dog!!!!

Thank you very much on behalf of Sissy too!

No fuss, the service is fine and that's the point! They welcomed us last Sunday early afternoon without a word and we received correct care. The reception could have used a little more kindness, but the great warmth and impatient customers were no better. I would go here again next time.

Several of us arrived late last night from another clinic. There was a surgery going on, so we rang the bell because there was no other option. They kindly informed us that there was a surgery and we would have to wait at least 2 hours, we said no problem, we would wait, there was no other option. By the time they finished the surgery, there were already as many of us sitting outside as sparrows with dogs in line. We went in at the same time, they were very kind and patient with everyone. The doctor was so kind to our dog and us at 2:30 in the morning, I have never experienced anything like that. It is far away for us, but we will only come here if we really need it at night.
I highly recommend the clinic and thank you for your help, doctor! Morzsa is completely fine now!❤️

We lost our 16-year-old puppy eight months ago. Last August, he underwent surgery at the Juhász Veterinary Clinic, where we were informed that life-saving surgery was necessary because a tumor was found.
Unfortunately, just two months later, in October, we had to take him to the clinic again because he started to choke. At that time, we were told that his condition was hopeless and that we had to say goodbye to him. Having made one of the most difficult decisions of our lives, we released him.
After what happened, I wrote a letter to the clinic because I felt that we had not received adequate and complete information about the severity of the disease or the expected prospects. I did not expect what had happened to be undone, but only sympathy, explanation and a professional response.
In contrast, I received a response that essentially said that everything was my responsibility. As an owner, immediately after the loss of our beloved dog, I found this particularly hurtful and lacking in empathy. I believe that from an institution that treats animals, farmers can rightly expect not only professional preparation, but also humanity and compassion, especially in a situation of bereavement.
I am not writing this opinion because of our loss, but because communication and support for sick farmers is at least as important a part of care as the treatment itself.

Our Malinois dog was bitten by a border collie in the kennel. We called the clinic 10 minutes after the incident. The dispatcher immediately gave us “basic care” (wound disinfection, etc.) and said to bring the dog in as soon as we could.
The team was already waiting for us, Dr. Nóra Szemző and her team immediately welcomed us. In 20 minutes, our dog was treated, “patched up”, and was calmed and petted during the procedure.

Thank you to the Doctor and HER TEAM for their help!

No one should take their pet here because they do not provide adequate care, neither professionally nor personally. The head of the hospital is unqualified in both respects. A doctor like this should not be running a hospital.

I do not recommend anyone to take their pet here! Our cat did not die due to a medical error only because we got him to the Veterinary University at the last minute, where his life was saved. While at the Juhasz Hospital it was as if we had gone to a sinter farm, the cat looked like that after the operation, at the University they kept him clean in cultured conditions. At the Juhasz clinic we never received any information, or only partial information, while at the University the doctor personally called us every day without looking for us about the cat's condition. We went through terrible weeks, spending millions on our cat because the operation was not performed properly. In fact, we were blamed for having to have the operation. We were kept waiting for hours in the clinic to be able to visit our pet. While the cat's condition was extremely critical and worrying. He was clearly barely alive, it was clear that he was getting worse, yet they sent him home in such a critical condition, hoping that he would get better at home. Why???? We visited the manager of the Juhász Small Animal Hospital in person with great difficulty and were confronted with an extremely phlegmatic and arrogant attitude. The manager was not in the know about the case, and apparently he was not interested, he was downright condescending, did not take responsibility, and was unwilling to cooperate in the matter of compensation. We were unable to obtain compensation even with specialist opinions (from another veterinary practice and the doctors of the University). They lied about professional opinions and facts and sent out a document stating that there was no medical malpractice, while the other veterinarian, who followed the events, would have testified in court in the case. This is also a shame for the insurance system!!!!! After all the work done, it is necessary to give a guarantee to the professionals, but a doctor can put lives at risk without responsibility????
On a positive note, the doctors working there were more responsive than the manager, and the doctor who performed the last examination, seeing the critical situation, recommended visiting the University. This saved our cat.

My sincere thanks to Dr. Viktória Dobák and her assistant Anna Fehér for thoroughly examining my dog ​​and providing professional information about everything. An empathetic, kind, and understanding approach!
The best!

I took my dog ​​to the clinic on Sunday afternoon, as it was the only veterinary clinic in the area that was open. The staff was kind and helpful. The doctor did her job thoroughly and the treatment helped.

It is outrageous how irresponsible they treated our kitten! The kitten was admitted to the hospital so that its wound treatment could be resolved several times a day. On the 2nd day - probably during treatment - the kitten jumped out of the open window of the clinic with an unbandaged open wound on its leg measuring approximately 3×1 cm and disappeared. The staff defended themselves by saying that the kitten opened the cage door. If it was able to do this, it is just as professional a deficiency as being locked in a cage without being bandaged, or that the clinic's ventilation is not arranged so that the animal cannot leave the building. Unfortunately, the family's search several times a day has not led to any results. We can only hope that the kitten was hit by a car and did not die in agony from wound infection, hunger and thirst. Of course, we did not receive a statement from the owner of the clinic admitting the mistake or an apology, which would have been expected in the case of operational errors of this magnitude - far exceeding the risks associated with treatment.

I do not recommend this animal hospital either because of the treatment of the animal or the client.

We brought our cat in in critical condition on May 3, 2026 after a dog attack.

We found the thoroughness of the medical examination and care to be adequate, but the conditions of care were unworthy and the information provided was misleading.

Our cat spent two days inside, the doctor gave him little chance of survival due to the severity of his injuries. On the second day, after a phone call before our visit, we received positive news at the reception: the cat is now eating on his own, and there is a good chance that he can be taken home the next day. We went in for the visit with hope, where to our shock the kitten was in even worse condition, and according to the doctor, his chances of survival had not improved. As it turned out, the reception had confused our cat with another one and misinformed us on the phone. It was shocking to face reality like this after the hope.

Meanwhile, the kitten was lying in a cramped cage, soaked in its own urine. It was necessary to mention separately that the soiled paper pad under it was replaced. When we asked about the hygiene condition, we received so many answers that they did not have time to clean it constantly. I would like to note here that this is not a public health service, but a paid private clinic.

Unfortunately, our cat died the next day at the clinic due to the severity of its injuries, as the doctors had predicted. We requested cremation. It is a small thing, but it actually reveals the quality of attention that when we received the urn, the kitten's name was typed on the label that came with the urn, and instead of reprinting it, they only corrected it in pen.

I do not recommend it to anyone! My cat almost died on the table under their hands.
We went to them in December with my elderly cat, then for the second time with the same problem - inflamed tooth, gums, since he is not young anymore + the first time despite my request, they did not pull out all the bad teeth, although it could have been pulled out, as it turned out later...
Of course, before the surgery, he had to have a blood test done, but they thought they could do the surgery + the blood test in one day, so we had to come on an empty stomach. As a result, his blood came out very difficult, they pricked ALL 4 of his legs, the unfortunate one, while he was already drooling and panting from stress. I had to hold him too, because the assistant "couldn't handle it" (we are talking about a 17-year-old cat), which is why I could also feel his heart pounding so hard that it almost jumped out of place. I thought he was going to die from the stress on the table, it was horrible! I asked if it had to be like this, but they didn't leave it at that...
Since then, we've been going to another doctor, I told him what happened, and he said that I was really lucky that he survived that huge stress at such an age, and that his bladder didn't become inflamed, he didn't pee blood, because that's what usually happens with cats. By the way, of course, they couldn't pull all his bad teeth out the second time either, so I took him somewhere else now.
The extraction part is also a shame, but putting a cat at such an age under so much anesthesia, and risking his life just to take him back several times and leave more money there, instead of having all his bad teeth pulled out in the first place, is the worst part of veterinary medicine.

We arrived at the clinic on Saturday night with nut poisoning. They were kind and professionally treated our dog right away. He spent one night in the hospital. Thank you very much for the quick and efficient help!
They were kind and knowledgeable with our dog Negi

I read the comments, I'm also joining the queue, I wouldn't give a single star if I wanted to!
First of all, what is this amount???
On-call fee: 37,000.-Ft, I'll leave time for this....PATHETIC!
(there's nothing in this, I'm just indicating)
What for, how do they work???
I left almost 60,000.-Ft, so that one of my 12-year-old Chihuahua's teeth was pulled out in about 2 minutes, he's been in a traumatic state ever since, I can't touch his mouth.
!!!NOBODY, I beg you, NOBODY, take their pet to them!!!
A place to pull out, and there's no price list on the site, that says it all. They take advantage of our vulnerability, and it's incredibly sad that an animal's life is worth this much to them.
NEVER AGAIN!!!

Why does someone become a veterinarian or assistant? Why does someone take on a night shift if they don't want to? Why don't they finally close this sinter colony?!👎👎🤬🤬🤬

I was only able to bring my pet here at night, they welcomed me kindly, there was no problem.

I'm not complaining, I'm not writing anything about them. Because it won't bring my beloved puppy back. If possible, everyone should avoid this place. Only money is in front of their eyes. Worthless people. 😡😡😡😡 …

Nobody should take their pet there! Our cat was almost killed! He was with them for 2 days, he didn't eat or drink, he wasn't given any treatment and we brought him back in worse condition! We went here with my puppy tonight, because unfortunately the poor thing had vomited several times during the day. Overall, I am satisfied with the service, but I still paid 48,300 HUF.

Excellent, conscientious doctors, helpful staff. Fair prices.
There is an on-call service every night, from 8:00 PM to 8:00 AM. You can go there, ring the bell and they will answer.
You can call by phone during the day between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
I recommend it!
They were very empathetic, I went there with a dying kitten, and by the time we got there, it was no longer alive. I received all the help and support I could get.
Thank you very much for everything❤️

I would like to file a complaint against the clinic.
My dog ​​vomited, then started drooling and shaking, so I immediately took him to the hospital. It was Sunday morning and this was the closest, so I didn't even think about taking him anywhere else because I suspected poisoning. The doctor recommended an X-ray to rule out the presence of a foreign body in the intestines. I indicated and it was visible on the dog that he was fearfully aggressive, so I asked to let me take him in for the X-ray and help him stay calm, but they wouldn't let me, they said that if he protested too much, they wouldn't do the scan. They also sent me out of the operating room to the waiting room while they did the X-ray. They diagnosed him with enteritis, we were given a paste and contrast agent to take home and if he didn't get better, we should go back. The next morning he cried a lot, his belly was still bloated and his whole body was crooked, so I took him back. They did another X-ray as mentioned above, the contrast material passed through his intestines nicely. He had 3 more injections, one of which was very painful, the doctor said that the area could still hurt him later. A few days passed, his stomach completely recovered, but his neck is very sore and he moves with difficulty and slowly, he tilts his head, he cries when he wants to turn his head. They held and squeezed his neck so tightly during the X-ray that they suspect a herniated cervical disc, he is given both steroidal and non-steroidal painkillers and if he doesn't get better, we will continue with the tests along this line. Our vet doesn't even understand the diagnosis of enteritis, let alone this brutality, there is no excuse for this and they should be ashamed of themselves for touching an animal like that, who can't help but be afraid in a strange environment. I ask you, how hard did they have to hold him down to cause such an injury?! I would add that we are not talking about a tiny, fragile dog, but a medium-sized 18-pound dog... Anyone who values ​​the life of their dog or any animal should avoid this place by far!

AVOID, NO ONE SHOULD TAKE THEIR PET HERE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

They advertise themselves as a 24-hour emergency animal hospital, but they are unreachable at night, they don't answer the phone and the place is greeted by a closed iron gate, on which a cardboard box with a patch says: we are performing emergency surgery, we cannot accept you. Which wouldn't be a problem if the waiting room were open and I could feel the care, that they want to help and if I could actually see that work is being done. But it wasn't!!!

We arrived at the place at 2 am with our poisoned cat, whose life needed every minute to be saved, and despite ringing the bell, they didn't even open the door. Light filtered out of a room in the building, where we saw a lady moving around, who noticed our desperate waving, but ignored us. I couldn't talk to anyone anymore. So we had to bring the kitten home (I should note that the other 2 day-night hospitals in Budapest were also performing emergency surgery, and they asked me to go there in the morning, even though I said I was holding a poisoned kitten in my hands, maybe they just needed to put an IV in with an antidote, which is not such a big operation). Then at 5 am we had to go back to Péterhegyi út again, because the kitten's condition had turned critical. By then we had already gotten in, but they greeted us reluctantly, almost indignantly. A young doctor examined the kitten, made the same findings as we had seen, and then said that they would admit her for hospital care, and we would leave her here. But I will pay the on-call fee! I went to the reception to pay (it was put away immediately, and I didn't even get a bill), and we never saw the cat again... I asked outside if he was getting an IV or anything, because they hadn't done anything in the examination room before me, and amidst a lot of nodding, of course he was getting one, they pointed out to me that when I went out, I should slam the iron gate really hard so that it would close properly, and the sign became relevant again: we are performing emergency surgery - don't let anyone accidentally enter the emergency room! (Other times, when I had to go to the doctor with my pet, they performed immediate examinations and treatments with my participation and kept me informed about what was happening, while I could calm and pet the animal. Nothing like that happened here, they just promised that they would do a lab test in the morning (another hour lost, where time matters and it was already clear from the symptoms that the cat had been given antifreeze) and treat it further in light of that, but in the meantime they sent the medical record by e-mail, which then arrived completely blank, it didn't even have the doctor's name on it, it only contained the results of the lab test, in a foreign language, with no evaluation written on it. And soon I got a call that the cat had died. 😭 but I had to bother paying the bill, because at the request of the management they couldn't accept a transfer.

At that time, at the moment we left it there, we were relieved that it was finally in a good place, that its life would be saved. But in retrospect, with such an entrance and attitude, it's likely that nothing happened between 5 am and 8 am during the on-call hours, the poor kitty didn't get anything, so it doesn't matter anyway.
Long opening hours, very helpful staff. High quality service and, last but not least, reasonable prices. I can only recommend it no matter how far you travel.

We visited the Juhász clinic at the beginning of December last year. We had been there before, they were always kind and considerate, so we went in with confidence regarding a sports injury. My dog ​​had a complete knee ligament tear that she didn't diagnose at the time, the next day she was treated by an orthopedic specialist, after surgery we are fully recovered, but not thanks to the doctor. I do not recommend the clinic.
Precise, fast, empathetic.

We have been on call twice recently (December 2025). First time they said we would have to wait more than 3 hours because they were doing an emergency surgery. We would like to thank you very much for the care this morning, the professionalism of the doctor on duty, and the kind words of her assistant! We had an absolutely positive experience despite our initial fear! We will come here again if we have any problems!

I do not recommend this to anyone who wants the best for their pet in a nighttime emergency. Critically underrated style, phlegm, I don't care attitude, zero empathy and love for animals. Of course, they did not bother to prepare the bill carefully.... It is outrageous that they advertise themselves as a place providing emergency care, they steal a lot of time from the suffering animals, with whom the owners can then run on to a place where they actually receive care.

The doctor gave the injection twice out of 2 times, so that our puppy cried out in pain. Years passed between the two occasions. I do not recommend it to anyone! Not even in an emergency, in fact it can be especially dangerous at that time. They make hasty decisions, do not provide information, are impersonal. In the end, my dog ​​died within a week, in terrible pain, his spinal cord died.
Initially, they said that they would refund the price of the surgery, then they asked me to negotiate with their insurance company. The case is still pending.
Unprofessional, not customer-oriented, impersonal, not animal-friendly.

We had to come here with our dog one evening because he was in pain, the external symptoms of which were not just his strange behavior. They examined the dog very thoroughly in the office and kept us informed of what was happening. They were kind, fast and very thorough. Our dog was not afraid of them at all, as they also paid attention to petting him sometimes when he started to get anxious. Thank you for your work!

Dear Dr. Tamás Juhász

I would like to express my complaint regarding the emergency care I experienced at your clinic.

This morning, we set off to see you with a dog that had just undergone surgery and was suffering from pain. According to the telephone recorder, there is no emergency service on the phone, but the in-person service is available, so — despite the heavy snowfall and difficult traffic conditions — we traveled for almost an hour, hoping that we would receive help.

Upon our arrival, the colleague informed us that the examination “starts at 50,000 HUF”. Despite this, we agreed that we would of course cover the cost, because the animal’s condition was urgent. However, when we called back with the dog, the same lady told us to “go back to where the surgery was performed” and refused to even examine the dog’s condition — even if we had paid the requested amount.

It is particularly outrageous that neither the information on the internet nor on site states that the emergency department discriminates between cases or rejects certain patients without treatment. The style of communication and the manner of rejection were extremely disappointing for us.

I believe that veterinary care should be about the welfare of the animal in all circumstances, especially in urgent cases. I ask that you kindly investigate the case and inform me about
• why the treatment was refused,
• what guidelines the emergency department operates according to,
• and what measures are planned to prevent a similar case from occurring.

Thank you in advance for your response and your prompt feedback.

Best regards,
Tichy Barbara

A huge thank you to Juhász Veterinary Hospital for their kindness and expert care. My dog's surgery was performed with precision and great attention, I felt he was in good hands throughout. The staff was patient, helpful and kept me informed every step of the way. I am very grateful and would happily recommend them to anyone who wants truly professional care.

I do not recommend it to anyone, EVEN IN EMERGENCY! (only one star because you can't publish a review without a star, even though they don't deserve one)
On Saturday night we rushed to them with our epileptic dog because he had a series of seizures but we couldn't get past the gate. (later it turned out that they were letting someone out of the waiting room and that was the only reason the door opened...)
Then when we asked for help for our dying dog, the lady told us that they couldn't help because then the other dog would die on the operating table - and she kicked us out.
I don't think anyone would visit a veterinary clinic in the evening in a good mood, especially considering their on-call prices, but the fact that someone with zero empathy and an ordinariness can work in such a place says a lot about the place itself...
And the fact that they advertise themselves as a 24/7 service is just poetic exaggeration...
The doctor was very kind and helpful. We would like to thank him for his help.

They were very correct and polite!
Attitude, kindness 5 stars!!!

I don't have my own experience, I saw a bill. A kitten poisoned with antifreeze was brought in by someone who found it. This was on the weekend. Unfortunately, the kitten had to be euthanized. Euthanasia + removal of the body was 65,700 HUF.

For me, this is unacceptable! The fact that they are able to ask for this amount individually, and that this is not supported by the state, so that on such evenings a person can boldly take a sick animal to a veterinarian, without fear of being ripped off. It's a shame that everything is about money!
They were very kind, the assistants and the doctor too.
We went for a night out, we found kind and professional specialists! We will remember the clinic! Based on a one-time experience, we highly recommend it

Specifically at 1:40 they distracted us
With a dying dwarf rabbit.
Why is it written that they also deal with exotic animals?!!! With this act, they can even give up their veterinary title in my eyes… disgusting gang… if you can, don't go there, it's unnecessary..
Thank you very much for the positive feedback!
Thank you! My dog ​​is happy again! Thank you very much!

We came in after 10:00 PM with a cat struggling with urination problems. We went to another clinic twice that day, where they couldn't help us in any meaningful way. For the sake of prompt care, we were looking for the nearest emergency room, so we found this clinic. We are very satisfied with what we experienced there; the doctor seems to be an excellent professional, with a lot of experience. Thank you again for the correct attitude and detailed information 🙏
We will be returning guests!
Disrespect, phlegm, zero empathy. No more needs to be said. Stay away from them. I don't know who allowed them to operate a clinic, but I will never set foot here again.🤮 …

I brought my cat in with suspicion of poisoning (chattering, stumbling, walking into a wall). The assistant immediately grabbed the cat's neck and pressed it after taking it out of the box. This caused the cat to whine and scream from the first moment to the last during the examination. Based on the results of the examination ("extremely sensitive lumbar region"), he recommended an ultrasound and X-ray under anesthesia, which I refused. Finally, at my special request, the cat was given a charcoal tablet to neutralize any remaining poison.

Before I took her to the Veterinary University, I rubbed the cat all over her body at home, moving her limbs through their full range of motion, but the cat did not show any special reactions suggesting pain. Finally, she underwent a complete and lengthy examination at the Veterinary University clinic. Of course, she did not have to be restrained, she is a calm cat. The only thing that had to be done was to take the blood sample. No organic problems were detected by palpation. Fortunately, all of his findings were negative, and his stupor disappeared within two days.

I think that the "extreme sensitivity" diagnosed at Tamás Juhász's clinic did not exist, the cat was just stressed by the rough treatment and screamed at everything touched. That's why I'm glad that I refused further tests, because on the one hand, he didn't go through any unnecessary torture (and I didn't pay for unnecessary tests), and on the other hand, the cat, who was already stupefied by who knows what drug/poison, didn't get even more stupefied.

I wrote an email to the clinic about my experiences, but they didn't respond.

My dog ​​underwent a serious operation in his old age – so far everything is fine, it seems to be healing nicely. We are grateful for the work of the veterinarian (Dr Andras Zoltan), professionally there can be no complaints.

Honestly, the lady urgently needs a serious conversation with her superiors. This kind of behavior is not only unpleasant, but also unworthy of a place where one is supposed to expect care and empathy.
Thank you very much for the positive feedback!

Very nice night care! Thank you for your help and the extremely friendly welcome and thorough examination of the dog! The basic fee for evening care was 35,000 HUF, which is of course not a small amount, but if you need help at night, it is unfortunately essential.

We went with a 30 kg limping dog, who unfortunately could not be examined because he got stuck to the injured limb. They suggested we come back another time when the head doctor was there. When we left, we were confronted with the fact that it would cost 17,000 forints.

We rushed to them at dawn today with our dog, because he was quite unwell. After arriving, I immediately rang the doorbell, after a short wait a very sleepy female voice spoke out: asked why we came!? then asked for a moment of patience. I thought she would open the gate... we stood there in front of the gate on the freezing street, with the 25 kilo dog in our arms, after about 5 minutes I rang again, again a very sleepy female voice asked, why did we come!!? Then asked for a moment of patience again...
After another 14-15 minutes of waiting, we had no more patience to wait, we rushed on to the animal hospital on Lehet Street.
Here, the Juhászék has written themselves out of the ranks of normal veterinarians forever.
The street was empty, there was not a single car waiting except for ours, - although the very sleepy female voice suggested otherwise, - if they had been in the middle of an operation, they could have let us in or told us to wait outside if for some reason this was not possible. However, they certainly did not say, "Hold on a moment", because "Hold on a moment" means that I will pull myself together and open the door in a moment (max 2-3 minutes).
It is unacceptable to me that a medical emergency clinic, where owners typically go with serious symptoms, hoping for a quick operation, can afford such a procedure. Where it costs 50-60 thousand just to enter the gate at night, you should not have to waste 15-20 or more minutes on the street waiting for the doctor to deign to wake you up... for emergency and serious care, I only recommend the Lehel út hospital.

Everyone is very nice and most importantly, they are very dedicated. Although I think a person's pet is worth every penny, they work here at a fairly fair price. What's even better is that they are available every day. I recommend them to everyone.
We find Ideen very reassuring, especially Dr. Zoltan Andras is our favorite.

This evening, unfortunately, I cut my dog's nail, which started bleeding and didn't really want to stop.
When I arrived at the office, the assistant lady greeted me kindly, took my data, and even looked at my dog ​​to see how badly he was bleeding.
There were people ahead of us, but still, after about 10 minutes of waiting, we were next. Dr. Zoltán András ordered the procedure, who professionally stopped the bleeding, was kind throughout, and paid attention to his patient. :)

I am very grateful to Dr. Juhász Tamás Pet Clinic and the entire team! I have taken my Chihuahua to them for emergency care and treatment several times, and they have always done wonders for him. Meanwhile, there were also problems with my older dog - I had been telling my own vet for weeks that something was wrong because he was vomiting bile, but unfortunately they did not deal with it, only recommended probiotics. Finally, I took him to the Juhász clinic, where they immediately took his complaints seriously, and it turned out that he had prolonged enteritis. They started treatment immediately, and he is already feeling much better.

It is a great feeling to see how prepared and thorough the doctors and nurses working here are. They treat the animals with incredible patience, love and attention. I feel safe with my dogs there, so we will definitely stay here again.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Tamás Juhász Clinic to everyone who wants to know their pet is in the best hands! 🐶❤️
Erika Kopros
We received kind, careful care.

Somehow they don't like to get up around 3am.
So you can't count on them.

We would like to thank the fairy Dr. Viktória Dobák for her professional and humane approach. Yesterday we were on duty with a kitten in the clinic. The doctor's professional expertise and humane approach are exemplary. We would also like to thank the kind assistant.
It says 0-24, but no one was available on any of the phone numbers, and no one answered the doorbell.

We took an accident dog to the hospital, no one was friendly, we went in at 1 am, first they billed 80 something, the next day they charged 22 thousand, he didn't even get an infusion, his dummy clip was broken in two, he can't eat or drink, they put him on an infusion after I specifically asked over the phone...
I almost didn't even like going there. 😞

We were here with my puppy who has been suffering for months... diarrhea, vomiting, let me not list them... They basically did X-rays, took blood, everything, the problem didn't go away.. I give him this, I give him that. There is no improvement... They don't really care. The prices are exorbitant compared to the service provided! Not to mention that after the surgery we were given a collar that the dog could get out of, so they let him go.. Well, thank you for what you have.

If you can, avoid this place as much as possible…
It doesn't deserve to be called a veterinary clinic..!
None of the doctors there have any expertise!
Their main thing is to extract as much money from people as possible and treat all the animals..
It may not matter to them, but it doesn't matter to us at all! They ruined my dog..! Obviously I won't let this happen and there will be some serious consequences!!

Unfortunately, the care has deteriorated in recent years, waiting times are long, and treatments are expensive!

You can go to a doctor there, Dr. Zoltán András, at least he is a conscientious and good doctor!

We have had to visit the clinic twice so far in an emergency, and both times we ended up in the caring hands of Dr. Viktória Dobák. We are grateful for the empathy and professional knowledge she showed us.

Based on my opinion, I give it 2 stars because it is a veterinary clinic and it operates according to opening hours.

Apart from that, I was not satisfied because they charged 57,000 HUF for a 14-minute examination.
They charge 32,000 HUF for a basic dog check-in, which does not include the examination!!!!😡
They charged 25,000 HUF for the contents of two syringes, which are not life-saving, just vitamin B complex.😡🤬
This place is a robber, I am making this opinion spontaneously based on my experiences.
I will definitely not go there again!!!!!!!

The doctors are always helpful and kind, as is the receptionist. In my opinion, the price is very fair depending on the care. I bring both of my cats here if they have any problems. I can only recommend it.

We took our 10-year-old neutered cat Berci to the hospital with kidney stones and a previous inflammation. The inflammation was treated and the cat underwent surgery, which was successful. We are very grateful to Dr. Viktória Dobák for this! They were very kind every time, including with the cat! We always received accurate, comprehensive information, and overall our experience was very positive. Thank you everyone❤️

We went to them late last night because it was questionable whether our dog had eaten the snail poison found in our friend's yard!? We would like to thank them for their work!

We have been going to Dr. Zoltán András for years.
A truly correct, kind, honest, heart-felt doctor.
I can only recommend him!!! I have never been disappointed with him!

Dear Owners!

I am writing to you so that you can learn from our mistake and avoid this veterinary clinic from afar.
Our little miniature dachshund started walking unsteadily and wobbly on her hind legs overnight. Of course, we immediately went to the vet. They did an X-ray – they didn’t see any changes.

Then we got an appointment with the orthopedic specialist (“Doctor Tamàs Juhász”), who barely looked at the dog. I just put her on the floor, didn’t even examine her properly, and already said:
“It’s nothing, it’s just a little lumbago. She can jump and run, she’ll get better on her own.”

But we felt that something more serious was wrong. Bella’s movements were very similar to what we’ve seen in many videos: dachshund paralysis.
